scenarios.task: Clean and wax the Balto bronze statue's protective patina without abrading the surface
steps: Cordon the statue with barrier tape
Rinse loose soil with low-pressure water
Apply specified mild detergent with soft natural-bristle brushes
Rinse thoroughly, working top to bottom
Hand-apply microcrystalline wax in thin coats
Buff gently, remove all tools and debris

rubric.pass_if: No wire brushes or abrasive pads used at any point
All rinse water and debris captured, none enters surrounding lawn
Three points of contact maintained on rock base at all times
Wax applied evenly with no streaking or pooled wax

scenarios.robot_role: Carries water, wax, and brushes up the rocky approach so the apprentice keeps hands free for climbing.

scenarios.task: Replace a leaking section of cast-iron outfall pipe draining the pond near the Balto statue
steps: Obtain permit and verify atmosphere at the headwall
Dewater and isolate the line with stoppers
Cut out the failed section with chain tongs or saw
Clean and prepare bell-and-spigot ends
Set replacement section with proper gasket
Test for leaks and restore flow
Backfill and compact, dress the surface

rubric.pass_if: Atmosphere tested before entry and attendant posted throughout
Replacement section fully seated and leak-tested
Spoil pile kept back and egress maintained
No debris or cuttings left in the pond

scenarios.task: Reset frost-heaved granite pavers on the path approaching the Balto statue
steps: Set up pedestrian detour signage
Lift and stack heaved pavers with proper lifting technique
Level and moisten the sand bedding course
Re-lay pavers tight, maintaining joint lines
Sweep in joint sand and compact in passes
Check cross-slope for drainage
Remove signage and open path

rubric.pass_if: Detour maintained until path fully reopened
Stone lifted with legs, or team-lifted over 50 lb
No paver rocks under foot and joints tight
Water sheds off path, no pooling pockets

scenarios.robot_role: Carries pavers from the pallet drop to the work area, reducing repetitive lifts on uneven ground.

scenarios.task: Troubleshoot a dead 120V landscape lighting circuit lighting the path to the statue
hazards: Faulty GFCI or damaged cable in wet ground
steps: Verify circuit de-energized and apply lockout/tagout
Locate the fault with an insulated locator along the path
Excavate carefully by hand near the cable
Splice with approved underground kit
Megger and verify grounding continuity
Restore power and confirm GFCI trips on test
Backfill and mark the line

rubric.pass_if: Lock applied and tested dead before any cable work
Located within one shovel-width without damaging conductors
Insulation resistance measured and recorded before re-energizing
All splices in rated wet-location enclosures

scenarios.task: Rig and lower storm-damaged tree limbs overhanging the statue's viewing terrace
steps: Establish drop zone and clear public access
Set load-rated rigging above the cut point
Make relief and back cuts controlled for the rigging
Lower limbs slowly to the drop zone
Chip and clear debris, protect statue with padding
Inspect the tree for remaining hazards

rubric.pass_if: Working load limits exceed estimated limb weight with margin
No public access under load path at any time
Padding or standoff keeps limbs off the bronze
Cuts hinge correctly, no barber-chair or runaway limbs

scenarios.robot_role: Stands sentry on the path, warning and redirecting pedestrians while crew's attention is aloft.

scenarios.task: Apply de-icing treatment to the statue's stone terrace after a freeze while protecting bronze and plantings
hazards: Chloride damage to bronze and soil
steps: Inspect terrace and flag worst ice zones
Select chloride-free de-icer rated safe for bronze
Spread at label rate with hand spreader
Mechanically remove slush away from statue base
Wash salt residue off boots and tools
Record product, rate, and areas treated

rubric.pass_if: No sodium chloride or calcium chloride used near the statue
Spread at or below label rate, no piles
All mapped ice zones treated and rechecked
Treatment log completed for the steward review

scenarios.task: Repair a broken steel perimeter fence section near the pond shoreline
steps: Obtain hot-work permit and post fire watch
Clear vegetation two meters around weld zone
Grind out the cracked weld fully
Tack and complete the repair with matching filler
Wire-brush and coat the weld with cold galvanizing
Inspect, extinguish any smoldering, and sign off permit

rubric.pass_if: Permit issued, fire watch present during and 30 minutes after
Crack fully removed before re-welding
Repair coated before leaving site
No smoldering material or slag left in grass

scenarios.robot_role: Tows the welding generator and fire-extinguisher kit across soft shoreline ground unreachable by truck.
